caption:
Unpopular opinion: a 7% mortgage rate changes the whole math of buying a home. 🏠

Freddie Mac says the 30-year average is 7.32% this week. A year ago it was 6.19%.

Same house price, much bigger monthly payment.

Would you buy at this rate or keep renting?
first_comment: Buy now, or wait for lower rates? 👇
